panels.description: -- Averages lead_time_minutes converted to days per assignee for issues created in the window, scoped to boards mapped to the selected project.

targets.rawSql:
select * from (
  SELECT replace(COALESCE(
        NULLIF(TRIM(a.full_name), ''),
        NULLIF(TRIM(a.user_name), ''),
        NULLIF(TRIM(ia.assignee_name), ''),
        NULLIF(TRIM(a.email), ''),
        '(unmapped)'
      ), '-', ' ') AS member, 
      avg(i.lead_time_minutes / 1440.0) AS Days
  FROM issue_assignees ia
  JOIN issues i        ON i.id = ia.issue_id
    JOIN board_issues bi    ON bi.issue_id = i.id
    JOIN project_mapping pm ON pm.row_id = bi.board_id
                          AND pm.`table` = 'boards'
                          AND pm.project_name IN (${project})
    JOIN accounts a       ON a.id = ia.assignee_id
    WHERE i.id LIKE 'github:%'
      AND bi.board_id IN (${repo_id})
      AND $__timeFilter(i.created_date)
      AND ia.assignee_id IN ( $developer_id )
    GROUP BY member
    LIMIT 100
  ) base
order by Days desc

panels.title: Average Time for Issue Resolution (By Individual)

panels.description: Per assignee, counts issues created in the window split into Task versus Bug by whether original_type contains 'bug', scoped to boards mapped to the selected project, top 20 by total issues.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT
  REPLACE(COALESCE(
    NULLIF(TRIM(a.full_name), ''),
    NULLIF(TRIM(a.user_name), ''),
    NULLIF(TRIM(a.email), ''),
    NULLIF(TRIM(ia.assignee_name), ''),
    'unassigned'
  ), '-', ' ') AS assignee,
  SUM(CASE WHEN i.original_type not like '%bug%' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS Task,
  SUM(CASE WHEN i.original_type like '%bug%' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS Bug
FROM issue_assignees ia
JOIN issues i           ON i.id = ia.issue_id
JOIN board_issues bi    ON bi.issue_id = i.id
JOIN project_mapping pm ON pm.row_id = bi.board_id
                       AND pm.`table` = 'boards'
                       AND pm.project_name IN (${project:sqlstring})
JOIN accounts a       ON a.id = ia.assignee_id
WHERE i.id LIKE 'github:%'
  AND bi.board_id IN (${repo_id:sqlstring})
  AND $__timeFilter(i.created_date)
  AND ia.assignee_id IN ( $developer_id )
GROUP BY assignee
ORDER BY (Bug + Task) DESC
LIMIT 20;

panels.title: Work Allocation by Tasks and Bugs

panels.description: Per assignee, counts tasks created in the window split into Done versus Pending by status, scoped to boards mapped to the selected project, top 20 by total tasks.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT
  replace(COALESCE(
    NULLIF(TRIM(a.full_name), ''),
    NULLIF(TRIM(a.user_name), ''),
    NULLIF(TRIM(ia.assignee_name), ''),
    'unassigned'
  ), '-', ' ') AS assignee,
  SUM(CASE WHEN i.status = 'DONE' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS Done,
  SUM(CASE WHEN i.status <> 'DONE' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS Pending
FROM issue_assignees ia
JOIN issues i           ON i.id = ia.issue_id
JOIN board_issues bi    ON bi.issue_id = i.id
JOIN project_mapping pm ON pm.row_id = bi.board_id
                       AND pm.`table` = 'boards'
                       AND pm.project_name IN (${project})
JOIN accounts a       ON a.id = ia.assignee_id 
WHERE i.id LIKE 'github:%'
  AND i.original_type not like '%bug%'
  AND bi.board_id IN (${repo_id}) 
  AND $__timeFilter(i.created_date)
  AND ia.assignee_id IN ( $developer_id )
GROUP BY assignee
ORDER BY (Done + Pending) DESC
LIMIT 20;

panels.title: Bug Allocation (Done/Pending Distribution)

panels.description: Per calendar month, counts PRs created in the window by the outcome of their most recent non-author review: Approved, Changes requested, Commented only, or No review.

targets.rawSql:
WITH latest_review AS (
  SELECT
    pr.id,
    pr.created_date,
    (
        SELECT c.status
        FROM pull_request_comments c
        WHERE c.pull_request_id = pr.id
            AND c.type = 'REVIEW'
            AND c.account_id <> pr.author_id
        ORDER BY c.created_date DESC
        LIMIT 1) AS final_status
  FROM pull_requests pr
  JOIN repos r ON r.id = pr.base_repo_id
    AND r.deleted = 0
    AND r.id IN (${repo_id})
    AND pr.base_repo_id IN (
      SELECT pm.row_id FROM project_mapping pm
      WHERE pm.`table` = 'repos'
        AND pm.project_name IN (${project})
    )
  JOIN accounts a ON a.id = pr.author_id 
  WHERE $__timeFilter(pr.created_date)
    AND pr.author_id IN ( $developer_id )
  order by pr.created_date
)
SELECT
  DATE_FORMAT(created_date, '%b %Y') AS month,
  SUM(CASE WHEN final_status = 'APPROVED'          THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS Approved,
  SUM(CASE WHEN final_status = 'CHANGES_REQUESTED' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS `Changes requested`,
  SUM(CASE WHEN final_status IS NOT NULL
            AND final_status NOT IN ('APPROVED','CHANGES_REQUESTED')
                                                   THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS `Commented only`,
  SUM(CASE WHEN final_status IS NULL               THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS `No review`
FROM latest_review
GROUP BY DATE_FORMAT(created_date, '%b %Y');

panels.title: Monthly Contributions by PR

panels.description: Per reviewer, counts their latest review per PR as Approved, Rejected or Commented, excluding self-reviews, scoped to repos mapped to the selected project, top 20 reviewers.

targets.rawSql:
WITH ranked AS (
  SELECT
    c.account_id,
    c.pull_request_id,
    c.status,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
      PARTITION BY c.account_id, c.pull_request_id
      ORDER BY c.created_date DESC
    ) AS rn
  FROM pull_request_comments c
  JOIN pull_requests pr   ON pr.id = c.pull_request_id AND pr.base_repo_id in (${repo_id}) and pr.base_repo_id in (select pm.row_id from project_mapping pm where pm.table = 'repos' and pm.project_name in (${project}))
  JOIN accounts a ON a.id = c.account_id
  WHERE c.type = 'REVIEW'
    AND $__timeFilter(c.created_date)
    AND c.account_id <> pr.author_id
    AND c.account_id IN ( $developer_id )
)
SELECT
  COALESCE(
    NULLIF(TRIM(a.full_name), ''),
    NULLIF(TRIM(a.user_name), ''),
    NULLIF(TRIM(a.email), ''),
    'unknown user'
  ) AS reviewer,
  SUM(CASE WHEN rk.status = 'APPROVED'          THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS Approved,
  SUM(CASE WHEN rk.status = 'CHANGES_REQUESTED' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS Rejected,
  SUM(CASE WHEN rk.status NOT IN ('APPROVED','CHANGES_REQUESTED')
             OR rk.status IS NULL               THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS Commented
FROM ranked rk
  LEFT JOIN accounts a       ON a.id = rk.account_id
WHERE rk.rn = 1
GROUP BY reviewer
ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC
LIMIT 20;

panels.title: Contributions by PR Reviews

panels.description: Per author, counts PRs created in the window split by status into Merged, Closed and Open, scoped to repos mapped to the selected project, top 20 by total PRs.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT
  REPLACE(
    COALESCE(
      NULLIF(TRIM(a.full_name), ''),
      NULLIF(TRIM(a.user_name), ''),
      NULLIF(TRIM(a.email), ''),
      NULLIF(TRIM(pr.author_name), ''),
      'unknown user'
    ), '-', ' ') AS contributor,
  COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN pr.status = 'MERGED' THEN pr.id END) AS Merged,
  COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN pr.status = 'CLOSED' THEN pr.id END) AS Closed,
  COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN pr.status = 'OPEN'   THEN pr.id END) AS `Open`
FROM pull_requests pr
JOIN repos r ON r.id = pr.base_repo_id
  AND r.deleted = 0
  AND r.id IN (${repo_id})
  AND pr.base_repo_id IN (
    SELECT pm.row_id FROM project_mapping pm
    WHERE pm.`table` = 'repos'
      AND pm.project_name IN (${project})
  )
JOIN accounts a       ON a.id = pr.author_id
WHERE $__timeFilter(pr.created_date)
  AND pr.author_id IN ( $developer_id )
GROUP BY contributor
ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT pr.id) DESC
LIMIT 20;

panels.title: Contributions by PR

panels.description: Counts distinct commits authored in the window per contributor, scoped to repos mapped to the selected project, top 20 by commit count.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT
  COALESCE(a.full_name, c.author_name, a.email) AS contributor,
  COUNT(DISTINCT c.sha)           AS commit_count
FROM commits c
JOIN repo_commits rc      ON rc.commit_sha = c.sha 
    AND rc.repo_id in (${repo_id}) 
    AND rc.repo_id in (
        select pm.row_id 
        from project_mapping pm 
        where pm.table = 'repos' and pm.project_name in (${project})
        )
JOIN accounts a       ON a.id = c.author_email
WHERE $__timeFilter(c.authored_date)
GROUP BY contributor
ORDER BY commit_count DESC
LIMIT 20;

list.definition:
WITH scoped_repos AS (
  SELECT r.id
  FROM repos r
  WHERE r.id LIKE 'github:%'
    AND r.deleted = 0
    AND r.id IN ( ${repo_id} )
    AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM project_mapping pm
                 WHERE pm.row_id  = r.id
                   AND pm.`table` = 'repos'
                   AND pm.project_name IN ( ${project} ))
),
scoped_accounts AS (
  -- PR authors
  SELECT pr.author_id AS account_id
  FROM pull_requests pr
  JOIN scoped_repos sr ON sr.id = pr.base_repo_id
  WHERE pr.author_id LIKE 'github:%'
  UNION
  -- reviewers and commenters
  SELECT cmt.account_id
  FROM pull_request_comments cmt
  JOIN pull_requests pr ON pr.id = cmt.pull_request_id
  JOIN scoped_repos sr  ON sr.id = pr.base_repo_id
  WHERE cmt.account_id LIKE 'github:%'
  UNION
  -- issue assignees, scoped through boards (github board ids match repo ids)
  SELECT ia.assignee_id
  FROM issue_assignees ia
  JOIN board_issues bi ON bi.issue_id = ia.issue_id
  WHERE ia.assignee_id LIKE 'github:%'
    AND bi.board_id IN ( ${repo_id} )
    AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM project_mapping pm
                 WHERE pm.row_id  = bi.board_id
                   AND pm.`table` = 'boards'
                   AND pm.project_name IN ( ${project} ))
)
SELECT CONCAT(
         REPLACE(COALESCE(
           NULLIF(TRIM(a.full_name), ''),
           NULLIF(TRIM(a.user_name), ''),
           NULLIF(TRIM(a.email),     ''),
           '(unmapped)'
         ), '-', ' '),
         '--', a.id) AS Name
FROM accounts a
JOIN scoped_accounts sa ON sa.account_id = a.id
GROUP BY Name
ORDER BY Name
